sources.label: Morphe patches for W3School Adventure app
sources.author: W3Schools
patch_list: Prevents remote minimumClientBuild version lockouts and disables Play in-app review prompts on sideloaded builds.
Disables Meta AppEvents, AdServices attribution, AAID/InstallReferrer harvesting, and RevenueCat diagnostic telemetry while preserving login and billing.
Unlocks the hidden Billing Debug and Developer Console screens in Settings without switching away from production APIs.
Hides the Explore plans upsell card on the Streak screen and the Go unlimited link in Code Duel.
Redirects Google Play Services and Credential Manager to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) with package and signature spoofing so Google Sign-In works on re-signed builds.
Bypasses client-side energy consumption, reports full charges, and shows the unlimited energy UI.
Unlocks sequential lessons, checkpoints, and milestones on the curriculum map and removes overview unlock upsell banners.
